title: Python: give imports the may-skip walk, replacing S3's own condition (DEC-303 (a62) item 5, follow-up to GCLI-118)
description: DEC-303 (a62) item 5 and (a63), follow-up to GCLI-118 (landed in opum-ai/glyph-cli#198, b3fd5d3e). Imports keep S3's own condition (src/python/modules.ts ImportBinding.condition) for the alternatives rule, and GCLI-118 only ADDS conditionality for an import through maySkipStatement in starOverride. An import in a finally, or in a try body with only a finally, is therefore an alternative flagged multiplyBound though Python always runs it (a known limit). Give imports the same walk as defs and classes (maySkipStatement, which passes through a finally and a try-only-finally body) for the gate's alternatives too, and reconcile S3's condition. Not on the hold list.

acceptanceCriteria.text: an import in a finally and an import in a try body with only a finally are not alternatives of an earlier binding: red before and green after in both forms with the callee pinned and the full bin delta
imports in an if, elif, else, except, except*, case, for, while and with arm stay alternatives (existing fixtures unchanged)
a mutant that restores S3-only conditions is observed red
the five-pin corpus diff against dev is script-asserted with every moved site named; any in-repo edge created or removed comes to opum-doc before the clear

finalSummary: Landed as opum-ai/glyph-cli#206 (squash 86ee6c3d) after Opus round 1 APPROVE at head 3775dbe6 and opum-doc DEC-303 (a66) arm A. An import in a finally, or in a try body with only a finally, is no longer an alternative of an earlier binding; starOverride drops the S3-condition OR and the gate drops earlier bindings only when an always-running last import overrides them. All four acceptance criteria were checked on the record with their evidence (fixtures red on base and green after, existing arm fixtures unchanged, S3-only mutant observed red, five-pin delta byte-identical to dev). Non-blocking review notes are filed as GCLI-133; the general later-binding rule is GCLI-131.
